verses.en: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
verses.sm: Le lagi e, uai mai ia ou taliga, ona ou tautala atu ai lea; le lalolagi e, faalogologo mai ia i upu a loʻu gutu.

verses.en: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:
verses.sm: O laʻu mataupu E sisina ifo ia e pei o le ua, o laʻu tautalaga e toto ifo lea e pei o le sau; e pei o timuga i le vao muʻa, e pei o uaga foi i le vao iti;

verses.en: Because I will publish the name of the LORD: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.
verses.sm: auā ou te valaau atu i le suafa o le ALII; ia outou vivii atu i le silisili ese o lo tatou Atua.

verses.en: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.
verses.sm: O le Papa, e sao lava lana galuega; auā e tonu ona ala uma lava; o le Atua faamaoni, e le o ia te ia se amioletonu, o le amiotonu ma le amio saʻo lava ia.

verses.en: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.
verses.sm: Ua leaga i latou, e le o lana fanau, a o lo jatou ila; o le tupulaga faapiopio ma le faa‘ole‘ole.

verses.en: Do ye thus requite the LORD, O foolish people and unwise? is not he thy father that hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?
verses.sm: Tou te faapea ea ona taui atu i le ALII, le nuu valea e ma le le poto? e le o lou Tama ea o ia sa faatauina mai ai oe? c lc o ia ca na faia oc, ma na faatumauina oe?

verses.en: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.
verses.sm: la c manatua aso O lc vavau; mafaufau ia i tausaga o lea tupulaga ma lea tupulaga; fesili atu i lou tama, na tc tau mai ai ia te oc; o outou toeaina foi, latou te fai mai ai ia te oe.

verses.en: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.
verses.sm: O ona po na tofitofia ai e le Silisili ese o nuu, ma na faataapeapeina c ia le fanau a Atamu, na ia faia tuaoi o le nuu, e tusa ma le faitau o le fanauga a Isaraelu.

verses.en: For the LORD'S portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
verses.sm: Aua o le tofi o le ALII o lona nuu O le pese a Mose lea; o Iakopo o lona tofi lea ua fuafuaina.

verses.en: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.
verses.sm: Na ia maua o ia i le vao, O le mea e le awa, e wo ai manu feai, ma ua gaogao; na ia siosio ia te ia, ma aʻoaʻo atu ia te ia, na ia leoleo ia te ia e pei o lona tamatamaimata.

verses.en: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:
verses.sm: E pei o le aeto ona faaoso i ana tama, e faapepepepe i luga o ana tama, e fola ona apaau, e saposapo ia te i latou, e ave ia te i latou i luga i ona apaau;

verses.en: So the LORD alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.
verses.sm: sa faapea le ALII e toatasi ona ta'ita'i ia te ia, sa leai foi se atua ese e toalua ma ia.

verses.en: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;
verses.sm: Na ia faatietie ia te ia i mea maualuluga o le lalolagi, ina ia ‘ai foi o ia i fua o le fanua; na ia fafaga foi ia te ia i le meli mai le papa, ma le suáuu mai le papa ala;

verses.en: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.
verses.sm: O suāsusu toʻa o povi, ma suāsusu o mamoe, o e pepeti foi o tamai mamoe, ma mamoe poa o Vasana, o ‘oti poa foi, ma le saito e sili ona lelei; na e inu foi i le suavine totototo e le suia.

verses.en: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
verses.sm: Na puta lesuruna, ma ua vaogata; ua e puta, ua e tino tele, ua e puta lava; ona tuulafoaiina lea e ia o le Atua na ia faia o ia, ma ua “ino'ino o ia i le Papa o lona olataga.

verses.en: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.
verses.sm: Na latou faatupuina lona fuá ona o atua ese; na latou faaonoono ia te ia i mea inosia.

verses.en: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.
verses.sm: Na latou fai taulaga i temoni, e le o le Atua; o atua na le iloa e i latou; o atua fou, na se‘i tutupu, na le matatau i ai o outou tama.

verses.en: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.
verses.sm: Ua le manatua e oe le Papa na fanaua oe, ma ua e faagalogaloina le Atua na ia faia oe.

verses.en: And when the LORD saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.
verses.sm: Na silasila le ALII, ona ‘ino ‘ino lea o ia ia te i latou, ona o le faaonoono mai o ona atalii ma ona afafine.

verses.en: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai lea o ia, Ou te “alo oʻu mata ia te i latou, ia ou iloa pe se a lo latou juga; aua o le tupulaga faapiopio i latou. o le fanau ua le o i ai se faamaoni.

verses.en: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
verses.sm: Ua faatupuina e i latou loʻu fua i le mea ua le se atua; ua faaonoono i latou ia te au i a latou mea faatauvaa; o au foi, ou te faatupuina lo latou fua ia te i latou e le se nuu; ou te faaonoono ia te i latou i le nuu valea,

verses.en: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.
verses.sm: Aua ua si°a le afi i loʻu ita, e mu ifo foi ia e 00 lava i seoli è maulalo lava; e faaumatia ai le lalolagi ma ona fua, e mu ai foi faavae O mauga.

verses.en: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.
verses.sm: Ou te faaputuina i luga ia te i latou mea leaga; ou te faauma atu aʻu u fanafana ia te i latou.

verses.en: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.
verses.sm: E tinovavale i latou i le oge, e faaumatia foi i le mai vevela, ma le mala e fano ai; ou te auina foi manu feai ia te i latou, ma mea oona o gata o le eleele.

verses.en: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.
verses.sm: O le pelu i tua o le aai, ma le mata‘u i totonu, E faaumatia ai taulelea ma taupou, o tama meamea ma tagata ulusina.

verses.en: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:
verses.sm: Na ou fai ane, Ou te faataapeape ia te i latou, ou te faateaeseina lo latou faamanatuga i tagata;

verses.en: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the LORD hath not done all this.
verses.sm: ana ou le fefe i le faaonoono o e ita mai, neʻi le iloa e o latou fili, neʻi latou faapea ane, O tatou lima malosi, a e le o le ALII na faia o nei mea uma.

verses.en: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.
verses.sm: Auā o le nuu i latou e le o i ai ni pulega, ua leai foi se faautauta ia te i latou.

verses.en: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
verses.sm: E, ana latou popoto, ana latou iloa lenei mea! ina ia latou mafaufau i o latou iuga.

verses.en: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had shut them up?
verses.sm: Pe faapefea ona tulia e le toatasi le toaafe, ma tutuli e le toalua o afe e sefulu, ana le faatauina atu i latou e lo latou Papa, ma tuuina atu i latou e le ALII?

verses.en: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.
verses.sm: (Aua e le pei o lo tatou Papa lo latou papa, ua fai foi o e ita mai ia te i tatou ma faamasino i ai.)

verses.en: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are bitter:
verses.sm: Aua o lo latou vine mai le vine o Sotoma lea, mai fanua o Komoro foi; o latou fua o vine o vine cona ia, e oona foi o latou fuifuivine;

verses.en: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.
verses.sm: o le mea ‘ona o gata o latou uaina. ma le mea matuá ‘ona o asipi.

verses.en: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?
verses.sm: E le teua ca lenei mea e au, ma faamauina faatasi ma a‘u oloa?

verses.en: To me belongeth vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.
verses.sm: O ia te au le taui ma sui, atoa ma le taui atu i ona po e mapeva ai o latou vae; aua ua lata mai le aso latou te malaia ai, o loo faataalise mai foi mea a co ia te i latou.

verses.en: For the LORD shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.
verses.sm: Aua e faamasinoina e le ALII lona nuu, e salamó foi o ia ona o ana auauna, pe a silafia e ia ua mavae lo latou malosi, ma ua le toe se pologa po o se saoloto.

verses.en: And he shall say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai lea o ia. O fea oi aio latou atua, o le papa na latou faatuatua i ai,

verses.en: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.
verses.sm: oe na aai i gato o a latou taulaga, o e na inu le uaina o a latou taulaga i mea e inu? ia latou tutu mai, ma fesoasoani ia te outou, ia fai i latou ma lafitaga mo outou.

verses.en: See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia outou iloa o aʻu, o aʻu lava o ia, e leai foi se atua e toalua ma aʻu; ou te fasiotia, ma ou faaolaina; ou te taia, ma ou faamaloloina; e leai foi se na te laveai mai ai loʻu lima.

verses.en: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.
verses.sm: Auā ou te sii loʻu lima i le lagi, ma ou faapea ane, Ou te ola e faavavau.

verses.en: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.
verses.sm: Afai ou te faamaai laʻu pelu pupula; ma tago loʻu lima i le faamasinoga, ou te taui ma sui i e o fai aʻu ma fili, ma ou taui atu i e o ʻinoʻino mai ia te au.

verses.en: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.
verses.sm: Ou te faainu ia ona aʻu u fanafana i le toto, e “ai foi lau pelu i tino o tagata; o le toto o e ua fasia, ma e ua faatagataotaua, o alii sili o e ita mai.

verses.en: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.
verses.sm: Outou nuu ese e, ina olioli la faatasi ma lona nuu; auá na te taui ma sui le toto o ana auauna, na te tuuina atu foi le taui i e o fai o ia ma fili; e togiolaina foi e ia le laueleele o lona nuu.

verses.en: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.
verses.sm: Ua alu atu Mose, ma fai atu i upu uma o lenei pese a o faalogologo mai le nuu, o i laua ma Iosua le atalii o Nuno.

verses.en: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:
verses.sm: Ua uma foi ona fai atu e Mose nei upu uma ia Isaraelu uma lava;

verses.en: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
verses.sm: ona ia fai atu lea ia te i latou, Ia outou manatunatu i upu uma ou te taʻu atu ia te outou i le aso nei; tou te poloai atu ai i a outou fanau ia anaana e faia upu uma o lenei tulafono.

verses.en: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong your days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
verses.sm: Aua e le se upu faatauvaa lea ia te outou, ana o i ai lo outou ola; o lenei mea foi tou te faafualoa ai o outou aso i le laueleele, tou te sopoia atu ai Ioritana e fai mo outou.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai foi le ALII ia Mose i lea lava aso, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:
verses.sm: Ina alu ae ia oe i lena mauga, o Aperima, o le mauga o Nepo, o i le nuu o Moapi, o loo fesagai ma Ieriko; ma e vaai atu i le nuu o Kanana ua ou foaina atu i le fanauga a Isaraclu e fai mo latou.

verses.en: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:
verses.sm: E te oti foi i le mauga e te alu ae i ai, e faatasiina atu foi oe i lou nuu, e faapei ona oti o Arona lou uso i le mauga o Horo, ua faatasiina atu foi i lona nuu;

verses.en: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.
verses.sm: aua na agasala mai oulua ia te au i luma o le fanauga a Isaraelu i le vai o Meripa-katesa, i le vao o Tisina; aua na le faapaiaina o au e oulua i luma o le fanauga a Isaraclu.

verses.en: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.
verses.sm: E vaai atu oe i le nuu o i ou luma, a e te le oo i le nuu ua ou foaiina atu i le fanauga a Isaraelu.
